name: Mezameru to Itoko o Mamoru Bishoujo Kenshi ni Natteita
original_name: 目覚めると従姉妹を護る美少女剣士になっていた
source:
One day Ryou wakes up as a girl, which comes as a shock for him.

Apparently his family's main branch has long protected the secrets of oni mastering. Some of oni are displeased with this slavery and continuously target a member of the family with the highest Renki power, called the Oni-Pleasing Princess. The current Princess is Yume, Ryou's cousin and his secret crush.

Oni-Pleasing Princess receives a protector swordswoman, called the Oni-Cutting Princess. The protectors have always been female, and as Yume unconsciously wanted Ryou to protect her, he has awakened as Oni-Cutting Princess, at the same time transforming into a girl.

Now, oni are gathering to make an attack on Yume, and Ryou must use his newfound powers to hold them back.
translation:
有一天，凉一觉醒来，变成了一个女孩，这让他感到震惊。

显然，他家族的总支长期以来一直保守着鬼掌握的秘密。一些鬼对这种奴役感到不满，并不断地针对具有最高连气力量的家庭成员，称为“讨鬼公主”。现任公主是梦，凉的表弟，也是他的暗恋对象。

讨鬼公主得到了一位保护剑女，称为斩鬼公主。保护者一直都是女性，由于梦无意识地希望凉保护她，他作为斩鬼公主觉醒，同时变成了女孩。

现在，鬼们正在聚集起来攻击梦，凉必须使用他新发现的力量来阻止他们。
